data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 abstracts the relation between corroboration and action found in SRC_002 and SRC_005 by redefining the mechanism from 'prediction of truth' to 'heuristic for error finding'. REFUTED IF the act of choosing the 'least-worst' option for practical application inherently requires a belief that the future will not introduce new kinds of failures, thus silently reinstating the uniformity principle SRC_004 attempts to bypass.
